column1: # Held-out Ganjoor hemistichs carrying editorial marks, with a syllabified
# reading each. Same notation as readings-thiesen.tsv.
# provenance: "drafted:<model>" means a model wrote the reading and no person
#   has checked it: not a human annotation. A reviewer puts their handle there.
# Selection: 48 candidates, 12 per mark family (vowels, sukun, shadda, ezāfe
#   hamza), seed 24, from held-out single-metre lines in the eight commonest
#   metres. 14 were not annotated: Arabic quotation (0 8 11 13 15 18 19 23 25),
#   a line joined across a newline (17), no confident scansion (29 32 46), and
#   scanning in another metre than its label (38).
